title: The Extra Tenders Solicitation
peopleInvolved: Kitchen Supervisor at Bird of Prey
benefitOffered: Complimentary portion of salted butter tenders and honey sriracha dip in exchange for upgrading venue to Approved Rank 1
context: During the official 12:35 audit, Member Pendelton was observed exchanging conspiratorial glances with kitchen staff and attempting to return to the table with an unauthorised side carton.
outcome: Tenders promptly confiscated and consumed as physical evidence by the Chairs. Member Pendelton sentenced to 3 weeks of solo Tesco meal deal lunches.

title: The Cold San Pellegrino Gambit
benefitOffered: Uninvoiced can of San Pellegrino Aranciata Rossa and expedited melt queue priority
context: Vance-Cross attempted to conceal the chilled beverage inside his tailored trenchcoat whilst arguing passionately that Northern Soul belonged above Wright’s Fish & Chips.
outcome: Beverage seized. Offender ordered to draft a 500-word handwritten essay on the mathematical purity of distance-based ranking.

title: The Secret Voodoo Fries Infiltration
benefitOffered: Unrequested upsizing to Voodoo Fries with double cheese sauce without bill surcharge
context: Abernathy attempted to pass off the loaded fries as standard municipal issue. The excessive cheese sheen immediately triggered Chair Fletcher’s executive suspicion.
outcome: Official censure logged in the permanent ledger. The fries were catalogued and quarantined.

title: The Nduja Surcharge Waiver Conspiracy
benefitOffered: Waived £3 nduja topping surcharge and window booth reservation at Double Zero
context: Finch falsely claimed the pizzaiolo was his second cousin by marriage, attempting to bypass the 15-minute walking boundary rule.
outcome: Nepotism repudiated with cold disdain. Double Zero evaluated purely on crust blistering.

title: The Picanha Skewer Linger
benefitOffered: Table-side carver coaxed into making three consecutive stops at Higgins’ plate while the rest of table was declared red
value: Approximately 320g of prime rump cap (£14.00 nominal value)
context: During the quarterly payday audit at Fazenda, Higgins discretely turned his wooden indicator token to green beneath a bread napkin.
outcome: Token forcibly inverted to red by Chair Fletcher’s mahogany walking stick. Higgins assigned to note-taking duty for the subsequent four sessions.

title: The Fast-Track Burrito Pass
benefitOffered: Direct WhatsApp pre-order code bypassing the Deansgate queue at Listo Burrito
context: Attempted to exchange the private queue-jump privilege for the suppression of a sub-par inspection note regarding tortilla seam failure.
outcome: Bribe rebuffed. Seam failure noted in permanent archives; integrity of the ledger preserved intact.
